summary: Expand Tirannwn map areas beyond the Equilibrium promo pair (Prifddinas + Lost Grove) with Lletya, Isafdar, and Port Tyras. Document sub-place resolution in hardRules. Propose placeAnchors UVs inside the tirannwn ring. Do not apply Underground Pass here.

wikiSpelling.note: Lletya (not Llyta / Lletya misspellings). Port Tyras is the charter pier; Tyras Camp is the adjacent human camp.

exclusions: Underground Pass — Kandarin boundary in a separate patch; do not add under tirannwn areas or hardRules here.
Arandar, Poison Waste, Elf Camp, Arposandra, clan districts — out of this locked add set.

ops.rationale: Keep official Equilibrium marquee pair; append Lletya (pre-Prif elven village, SE Tirannwn), Isafdar (southern forest subregion), Port Tyras (SW charter landing). Tyras Camp is covered by hardRule only — not a fifth pin.

ops.rule: Treat Lletya, Isafdar, Port Tyras and Tyras Camp as Tirannwn. Do not expose them as separate selectable regions.

ops.geography: SE of Prifddinas / east Isafdar (wiki: rebel village in SE Tirannwn). East-south of Prif pin inside the eastern forest band.
Main southern Tirannwn forest, south of Prifddinas and north of the Lost Grove pin. Mid-forest band between capital and SW coast.
SW Isafdar coast / charter ship landing near Tyras Camp. West-south of Isafdar, north-west of Lost Grove island pin.

ops.note: After catalog apply, mirror the same areas array onto data/league/regions.json tirannwn.areas so planner region cards and map/catalog stay in lockstep. Also append the new hardRule to records[id=tirannwn].hardRules. Current league file only has ["Prifddinas","Lost Grove"] with empty hardRules.

proposedPlaceAnchorsCluster.uvBand: u ≈ 0.12–0.18, v ≈ 0.52–0.70 — clustered with existing tirannwn pins so smoothRing containment should pass; re-verify with placeAnchors.test.ts after apply

contentRows.note: No content[] rows in this patch. Lletya/Isafdar/Port Tyras are map/area expansions only; skilling and combat surface already lives under existing tirannwn upgrades (Prif districts, crystal tools, Morvran, etc.). Content renames for bare Prifddinas remain a separate audit step.

applyChecklist: Apply setAreas + addHardRule to data/research/catalog.json regions[id=tirannwn] (not done by this file alone).
Insert three upsertAnchor rows into src/map/data/placeAnchors.ts tirannwn block.
Mirror areas + hardRule to data/league/regions.json tirannwn.
Do not add Underground Pass under tirannwn.
